title: GPU computing: the software stack, architectural units and the cost of offloading
status: reviewed and locally validated; independent round 2 ACCEPT
transcript_provenance: Local machine transcription (faster-whisper small.en); not publisher captions
source_uncertainties: Intel2024PDF URL on the lecture frame returned an unsupported content type through the web tool. The individually opened dated March2023HTML guide supports the Intel architecture facts used here;no unavailable2024PDF claim is relied on.
Full-chip diagrams and enabled product configurations differ. No laptop GPC/TPC layout is inferred from the reported SM count.
No Ponte Vecchio/Xe-HPC GPU, NVLink connection or two-device PCIe peer path was available for execution; those facts are dated documentation-based evidence, not local measurements.
The reported clock is an API peak-frequency attribute,not a sustained clock sampled during the workload. The6.144TFLOP/s value is a nominal scalar-FMA model,not observed performance.
Three timing captures retain extrema of five trials per configuration,not every individual trial duration. No paired-trial speedup,physical-link rate or energy claim is made.

The CUDA13.0archived API pages provide documentation context. Actual CUDA13.3.1headers/version metadata were read;used APIs were compiled and executed. Older cudaDeviceProp clock fields are absent in those actual headers,so the program uses attribute queries.
One viewed W6L3frame(f0060)was black and supplied no evidence;adjacent f0061contains the comparison table.
PCIe4.0generation/coding arithmetic describes a standard-generation example,not the measured negotiated link of this laptop.

lecture_corrections.claim: V100NVLink25GB/s bidirectional per link gives300GB/s over six links.
lecture_corrections.correction: 25GB/s is per direction;50GB/s bidirectional aggregate per link yields300GB/s across six.

lecture_corrections.claim: PCIe peer communication always requires CPU-memory staging;no inter-warp switching;CPU has no API limitations.
lecture_corrections.correction: Supported PCIe peer paths can avoid host staging. Hardware selects ready resident warps without an OS context save for each selection. Both CPU/GPU software stacks have supported interface constraints.

lecture_corrections.claim: Architecture diagram/unit counts and shared-cache capacities apply uniformly.
lecture_corrections.correction: Full GV10084SM versus enabled V10080;full GA100128versus enabled A100108. The192KB combined capacity belongs to A100;V100uses128KB.

lecture_corrections.claim: 512/64elements times eight engines and FMA implies128FP64operations/core/cycle.
lecture_corrections.correction: Element count does not fix execution issue rate. IntelMarch2023guide specifies256FP64and256FP32operations/core/cycle for Xe-HPC.
Integer operations require integer-operation units;scalar floating-point and matrix/sparse peaks must be identified separately.
